scope: Exploratory context for all original copy-number calls; no new causal classification or automatic candidate exclusion.
population_endpoint_tolerance: One native bin at each endpoint; descriptive only, not allele equivalence.
flank_policy: Each flank has the call length clamped to these bounds and clipped to chromosome bounds. Show all markers and a separate subset outside every primary-review CNV.
allelic_interpretation: Preserve native diploid GT/AD/DP/PL and all exclusion reasons. ALT/(REF+ALT) is read balance at ascertained common SNPs, not calibrated B-allele copy state, mosaic fraction, phase or a clinical test.
